api_analysis.hypothesis: The compile errors are caused by the absence of the CUDA complex header <cuda_runtime.h> does not define cuComplex and make_cuComplex; need to include <cuComplex.h> or <cuda_runtime.h> with appropriate complex definitions. Also .cu launcher signature uses cuComplex while binding declares cuComplex leading to linkage/compile errors in binding. Must use float2 or c10::complex<float> consistently. The simplest fix: in .cu, include <cuComplex.h> and replace cuComplex/make_cuComplex with float2/make_float2, and update launcher signature to use float2*. In binding, declare with float2* and reinterpret_cast<float2*>(out.data_ptr<c10::complex<float>>()).
